history.text: Oleg took Kyiv and made it the capital of Kievan Rus'.
Roman the Great joined Galicia and Volhynia into one principality.
The Zaporozhian Cossacks fortified an island stronghold below the Dnipro rapids.
Khmelnytsky's uprising established the Cossack Hetmanate.
The Ukrainian People's Republic was proclaimed in Kyiv.
Skoropadskyi took power as hetman with German backing.
The Directorate restored the Ukrainian People's Republic.
A Soviet Ukrainian republic was established at Kharkiv.
